id.description: The worksheet's public name, also used as its inspection identifier.

index.description: Zero-based position in workbook sheet order.

anyOf.description: An A1 range within this worksheet.

range.description: A1 bounding range of the sparse cell collection, or null for an empty sheet.

cells.description: Sparse cell collection in row-then-column order. Absent worksheet positions do not produce cell nodes.

items.description: An A1 range within this worksheet.

populatedCount.description: Cells with a nonblank computed value, including errors.

blankCount.description: Blank positions within the inspected rectangular range, including absent cells and empty-string values.

numericCount.description: Cells whose computed value is a finite number. Dates, booleans, and numeric-looking strings are excluded.

textCount.description: Cells with a nonempty string value, excluding date and error values.

formulaCount.description: Cells containing a formula, including formulas that return a blank or error.

min.description: Minimum finite numeric value, or null when there are no numeric values.

max.description: Maximum finite numeric value, or null when there are no numeric values.

sum.description: Sum of finite numeric values; zero when there are none, or null when the sum exceeds the finite numeric range.

average.description: Mean of finite numeric values, or null when there are none.

id.description: Sheet-qualified identifier for this column's inspected range or empty table column.

letter.description: Worksheet column label, such as A or AA.

name.description: The native table column name, or first-row text for a detected region column. Absent for unnamed worksheet columns.

anyOf.description: An A1 range within this worksheet.

range.description: Inspected A1 range, or null when a table column has no body rows.

statistics.description: Computed values within this column's range. Table-column ranges exclude headers and totals.

id.description: Sheet-qualified A1 cell address, with the sheet name quoted when needed.

address.description: A1 cell address within the sheet.

value.description: Computed value. Dates are ISO strings, errors are error-code strings, and blanks are null or an empty string. valueType distinguishes these cases.

formula.description: Formula including the leading equals sign, when present.

error.description: Computed error code, such as #DIV/0!, when the cell value is an error.

text.description: Displayed text after the cell's number and text formatting is applied.

runs.description: Rendered text runs when visible fonts differ. Run text concatenates to the cell text.

mergedRange.description: Merged rectangle containing this cell, when present.

fillColor.description: Resolved color as #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA when translucent.

ComputedStyle.description: Resolved cell appearance from the renderer. For mixed rich-text fonts, font describes the cell default and runs supplies each actual text style.

color.description: Resolved color as #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA when translucent.
Resolved color as #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA when translucent.

items.description: An A1 range within this worksheet.

range.description: An A1 range within this worksheet.

Region.description: A connected region of populated/formula cells and statistics over its bounding rectangle. Column names, when present, come from first-row text.

DrawingAnchor.description: Drawing placement using A1 cells and pixel offsets/dimensions.

selectedItems.description: Explicitly selected item labels; empty when no manual selection restricts the slicer.

DataTable.description: A what-if data table and its input-cell bindings.

Note.description: A classic cell note, separate from threaded comments.

range.description: An A1 range within this worksheet.

formula.description: Source range formula for the series numeric values.

categoryFormula.description: Source range formula for category labels.

xFormula.description: Source range formula for numeric X coordinates in scatter or bubble charts.

valueCount.description: Positions in the series A1 source range, or literal data count. Null for other source expressions.

categoryCount.description: Positions in the category A1 source range, or literal category count. Null for other source expressions.

items.description: An A1 range within this worksheet.

rows.description: Rows with explicitly authored height or visibility.

columns.description: Column spans with explicitly authored width or visibility.

scope.description: workbook for a workbook-scoped name, or the worksheet's public name.
